args.title: Fix scheduling so the first weekly export runs on the creation day
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The `nextRunAt` function incorrectly schedules the first weekly run one week after the creation, causing the first export not to send on the creation day for weekly cadences. Change the weekly case in `nextRunAt` to check if the next scheduled run is after the current `from` date; if not, schedule the first run on the current day (or adjust logic to allow the export to run immediately). This ensures the first export for a weekly schedule is sent on its creation day, fixing the issue reported where the first weekly scheduled export never sends on the scheduled day.
